info.description:
Nucleus ERP is an open-source, API-first business suite designed for African businesses and beyond.
It provides a modern, modular, and developer-friendly platform for managing core business operations.
It also provides secure, scalable, and extensible endpoints for managing users, businesses, stores, inventory, suppliers, keys, and webhooks. Features include JWT authentication, API key support, rate limiting, activity logging, and comprehensive API documentation.

### Key Features
- **Authentication & Authorization**: Secure user management with JWT-based access control.
- **Business Management**: Create and manage businesses, branches, and organizational structures.
- **Point of Sale (POS)**: Process sales, payments, and receipts with support for multi-branch operations.
- **Inventory Management**: Track stock levels, suppliers, purchases, and transfers.
- **Finance & Taxation**: Manage taxes, VAT, and financial records.
- **Extensible via Webhooks & Events**: Trigger custom workflows (e.g., when a sale or inventory update occurs).
- **Audit Logging**: Automatic logging of key user and system activities for compliance.

### Target Users
- Small to medium businesses in Africa looking for ERP solutions tailored to their workflows.
- Developers and integrators building custom business apps on top of Nucleus API.
- Organizations needing a modular, open-source ERP that can be extended with plugins.

### Usage Notes
- All requests must include a valid JWT token in the `Authorization` header.
- API follows RESTful design and returns JSON responses.
- File uploads (e.g., business logos) must be sent via multipart/form-data.

## Authentication
- **JWT Token:** Obtain a token by POSTing to `/api/v1/auth/login` with valid credentials. Use the returned token in the `Authorization` header as `Bearer <token>`.
- **API Key:** Admins can generate API keys via the `/api/v1/key/generate` endpoint (requires authentication). Use the API key in the `Authorization` header as `ApiKey <key>`.
- See [API Docs](https://github.com/bontusss/nucleus) for more details.

Create a new business/organization record and link it to the authenticated user as the owner.

### Features
- Accepts required and optional business details (name, email, website, tax ID, motto, etc.).
- Allows uploading a business logo (JPG/PNG, max 2MB).
- Supports attaching custom metadata as a JSON object.
- Automatically sets the authenticated user as the owner of the business.
- Logs the creation activity for auditing purposes.

### Notes
- A default branch called "Main" is created automatically when creating an org.
- The `metadata` field must be a valid JSON string. Example: {"industry":"Hospitality","branches":5}
- The `logo` field must be a JPG or PNG image not exceeding 2MB.
- On success, the response includes full business details, metadata, and timestamps.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes a specific branch of a business.
Only the business owner (or authorized user) can perform this operation.
Once deleted, the branch cannot be recovered.

parameters.description: Branch ID (the unique identifier of the branch to delete)
parameters.name: id

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid authentication token

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have permission to delete this branch

patch.description:
Updates the details of a specific branch belonging to a business.
Only the branch owner (business owner) can perform this operation.
Fields not provided in the request will remain unchanged.

parameters.description: Branch ID (the unique identifier of the branch to update)
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Branch details to update (only include fields you want to modify)
parameters.name: branch

400.description: Invalid branch ID or bad request body

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid authentication token

403.description: Forbidden - user does not have permission to update this branch
